repairs.title: Fix Zero-Cap Crash in UNL Selector and Open Pull Request
repairs.criteria: Submit (1) the pull-request URL for postfiatorg/dynamic-unl-scoring containing the regression test, minimal fix, and one-paragraph justification; (2) a public gist URL containing the before-and-after output of pytest tests/test_unl_selector.py, showing the regression failing before the fix and all tests passing afterward; and (3) the Discord announcement message link from an approved Post Fiat channel linking the pull request and gist. Do not include secrets or private links.

repairs.title: Reproduce TUI Cooked-Mode Bug and Package Repro Evidence
repairs.criteria: Submit (1) the public gist URL containing the reproduction commands, terminal emulator and operating-system versions, full terminal output, expected versus actual behavior, and the terminal-mode source file and line reference; and (2) the Discord message link from an approved Post Fiat channel announcing that gist. Do not include passwords or secrets.
